case_name: Padmavati W/O Kamleshkumar Lakhani vs State Of Gujarat
facts_of_case: Parties entered into an agreement dated 09th December, 2020, to settle disputes. Certain dispute with regard to interest remains.

legal_principles.principle: The Registry shall intimate to the Court about the status of deposit and necessary order for release on apportionment of this amount towards maintenance shall be passed.
legal_principles.held: Once the amount is deposited, the Registry shall intimate to this Court about the status of such deposit and necessary order for release on apportionment of this amount towards the maintenance shall be passed by this Court.

legal_principles.principle: The concerned Family Court shall be requested for expeditious hearing of the matter without waiting for the period of six months.
legal_principles.held: Any such application is filed, the concerned Family Court shall be requested for expeditious hearing of the matter without waiting for the period of six month

outcome.final_order: Amount of Rs.23.00 lakhs shall be deposited within a week. Registry shall intimate about deposit and necessary order for release on apportionment shall be passed.
